notes.title: VR is coming out very soon !
notes.content:
Make your headset ready, Trialtime Reborn VR is coming out befors the end of the month !
You'll be able to play the game with your VR controllers from inside a desktop sized virtual world.

The DLC is totally FREE so don't forget to add it to you Wishlist now !
